answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding identities to bonded collateral in a shared vault: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence makes the penalty scale as O(k²), rather than as k isolated fines. Detection can also trigger asymmetric depreciation and forfeiture across linked escrows, so a swarm’s aggregate capital loss compounds with its size and may be exponential; an umber grove of aliases therefore offers no cheap escape from accountability.
